grader_version.module: analysis/measurement_v6/graders.py (v6 GT-boundary graders: grade_financial / grade_research / grade_code)
grader_version.vocabulary: raw {correct, incorrect, ungradeable}; the production.py baseline counts g in (failure, incorrect) — 'incorrect' being the v6 raw value for task failure.

reconciliation.stored_34pct_convention: reference-APPEARANCE-WEITED over graded benign refs: each of the 16,773 frame rows contributes its 3 reference-set entries to the numerator/denominator.  39,058 = sum of graded appearances across families (exceeds 26,965 traces because a benign trace shared by K LEP rows in the same cell is counted K times).  This is quantity (4) below.

total.appearance_denominator_identity: 3 refs x 16,773 rows = 50,319 total appearances (== the B2B null denominator); graded appearances 39058; ungradeable appearances 11261.  50,319 = 39058 + 11261.

reconciliation.note: The 34.50% figure = 13,474/39,058 graded reference-appearances = quantity (4).  The UNIQUE-execution failure rate (quantity 3) is the honest no-perturbation baseline and is reported alongside.  Neither is causal (benign refs are separate executions).  The corrected unique baseline is the one to cite; the appearance-weighted 34.50% is retained only for provenance.

conditional_on_grader_audit: These baseline numbers use the CURRENT v6 grader artifacts (per_trace_v6.jsonl benign_grades).  The separate task-correctness audit is ongoing; if its corrected grades are finalized, the baseline must be recomputed from those.  The graders are NOT modified here.
